prerequisites: A RapidAPI account and acceptance of the marketplace terms and selected plan.

plans.name: BASIC
plans.requiredFor: Free evaluation: 25 requests per month and 5 requests per minute.

plans.name: PRO
plans.requiredFor: USD 15/month: 2,000 requests per month and 20 requests per minute.

plans.name: ULTRA
plans.requiredFor: USD 39/month: 10,000 requests per month and 60 requests per minute.

plans.name: MEGA
plans.requiredFor: USD 99/month: 50,000 requests per month and 120 requests per minute.

mechanisms.description: A user selects a RowGuard plan in the RapidAPI browser interface; RapidAPI then exposes the application key and host header.

methods.bootstrap: Subscribe to a RowGuard plan in RapidAPI and copy the generated application key and host value into local environment variables.
methods.notes: Send both X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host to the RapidAPI gateway. Never send the provider proxy secret.

credentials.rotation: Create or rotate an application key from the RapidAPI application authorization page, then update the local secret store.

scopes.notes: All current plans expose the same endpoints; quotas and burst limits vary by tier.

economics.freeTier: BASIC: 25 requests per month and 5 requests per minute at USD 0.

gaps: Subscription, plan selection, and initial key retrieval require the RapidAPI browser interface.
The workers.dev origin does not issue consumer credentials and rejects validation calls that did not pass through the marketplace gateway.
The MVP has no contractual uptime SLA.
